plain.say:
Brannoch:
    Horseshoes. Nails.
    The ferry is late again and nobody on the landing is surprised; the ferryman's boy sits
    on a coil of rope, counting gulls, while two carters argue over whose turn it was to
    bring the lantern down from the toll house.
plain.narrate:
Rain on the thatch.
The ferry is late again and nobody on the landing is surprised; the ferryman's boy sits on a
coil of rope, counting gulls, while two carters argue over whose turn it was to bring the
lantern down from the toll house.

plain.dialogue:

    Maren: "The ferry is late again and nobody on the landing is surprised; the ferryman's
      boy sits on a coil of rope, counting gulls, while two carters argue over whose turn it
      was to bring the lantern down from the toll house."

She goes back to it.

plain.show_help:
COMMANDS (these don't take any game time)
  #character your character: attributes, wealth, equipment, abilities, passives
  #stats     every combat number: attack power, hit and crit chance, armor, ward, evasion
  #journal  people you've met and things you've learned
  #events   what has happened, in order
  #audit    where this session's record of every model call is kept
  #refusals the lines the game could not act on this session, and what it asked
  #report [note]  flag what you just read: it is saved with the calls behind it under logs/reports, and sent nowhere
  #credits  who made what the game is built from
  #inventory  what you carry and wear (#equip / #unequip to change it)
  #book     your abilities: what you bring (5 spells and 5 techniques at first) and what stays in your book
  #prepare  change what you bring, out of a fight and once a day, e.g. #prepare 1 3 4 or #prepare Firebolt, Ice Wall
  #prebuff  the buffs you cast before the first blow of a fight you start, e.g. #prebuff Stoneskin, Frost Armor (#prebuff none clears)
  #allocate spend attribute points from leveling, e.g. #allocate str 3 dex 2
  #enchant  see enchantments an enchanter here can bind into your gear
  #pronoun  how people see you: #pronoun she, #pronoun he or #pronoun they
  #resetlayout  put the info pane's buttons back in their original order (drag a button to move it; game window only)
  #help     this list
  quit      save and exit
  *text*    in asterisks is something you do, never say:  "I'll get to it." *I lift the sacks*
  "text"    in quotes is always said aloud. Plain text is read as usual.
  #stash    see what's in your item box (stored at inns with storage)
  #shop     see what the merchants here sell and buy, with prices
  #mount    your mounts and the stable here; #mount <name> to ride one, #mount none to walk
  #board    the adventurers' guild contract board (at the guild house)
  #quests   your contracts and requests, progress and guild rank
  #party    your companions and the adventurers travelling with you (#name <companion> = <new name> renames one)
  #standing how the groups of this town regard you; #rumors what is said of you; #correct <n> sets a false tale straight
  #dungeon  the floors of the dungeon here, what you've cleared, and when it will be remade
  #dialogue switch conversations between narrated and plain dialogue
  #numbers  show or hide the numbers under each round of combat
  #menu     save and go back to the main menu: continue, load another game, or start a new one
  #debug    toggle debug mode (shows what the engine decides)
Anything else you type is something your character does or says.
